title: The Live Cipher
author: Felix Yarrow
blurb: Hazel Fairweather, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
